subject: Mutual Plan Starter — one‑page template + slide pack for 45d evaluation
messages:
From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>
To: Aaliyah Thompson <aaliyah@stardata.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 21 Jun 2024 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Mutual Plan Starter — one‑page template + slide pack for 45d evaluation

Hi Aaliyah,

Great to meet yesterday — thanks for the context on Stardata's evaluation goals. I promised a lightweight starter kit we can iterate on together. Attaching two artifacts to kick off: a one‑page MAP template (doc) and a concise slide stack you can share with stakeholders.

High level intent: make the first 45 days clear so your product, infra, and procurement teams have aligned acceptance criteria. The doc includes:
- Objectives & success metrics (product & business)
- Key stakeholders & meeting rhythm
- Technical validation checklist (short)
- Decision gates & acceptance criteria for go/no‑go at day 30/45

Asks for this week:
1) Share a primary stakeholder list (names + roles) — we can drop them into the doc.
2) Pick a preferred day for a 30‑minute walkthrough next week (we recommend Tue or Wed).
3) Any procurement constraints (PO lead times, SSO requirements) so we flag them up front.

I've copied Ben (solutions) and Jordan (success) to align on tech validation tasks and the slide narrative. Jasmine will own the doc collaboration link and versioning.

Attachments: MAP_template_v1.gdoc (starter), MAP_slide_pack_v1.gslides, tech-validation-checklist.xlsx

Thanks — looking forward to your notes.

—
Chloe Martin
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
chloe.martin@redwood.com
(415) 555‑0192

From: Aaliyah Thompson <aaliyah@stardata.ai>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 21 Jun 2024 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mutual Plan Starter — one‑page template + slide pack for 45d evaluation

Thanks Chloe — this looks like exactly what we need. Quick notes from procurement and product: 
- Procurement: we'll likely need a standard vendor questionnaire answered before legal will sign off; I can loop procurement in if you want but would prefer that after we confirm the technical fit (so we don't surface the questionnaire prematurely).
- Product: preference is to shift the decision gate to Day 35 rather than 30 — gives us one extra week for internal demos.

Two asks from our side:
1) Can you add a short column in the MAP for "owner" next to each action? Makes it easier for us to assign.
2) We need the slide pack in PDF for execs — can you export and drop it to the drive link?

Also — Jordan, Ben: can you confirm the minimum infra tests we should run during week 1 (rate limit, latency at 95th pct, and a small data retention smoke test)?

I'll hold Tuesday and Wednesday afternoons for a quick walkthrough — prefer Wed 9:30am PT.

Thanks,
Aaliyah
Head of Integrations | Stardata
aaliyah@stardata.ai
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Aaliyah Thompson <aaliyah@stardata.ai>, Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 22 Jun 2024 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mutual Plan Starter — one‑page template + slide pack for 45d evaluation

Aaliyah — noted on Day 35, happy to move the gate. I've added a short "owner" column to the MAP doc and filled in primary ownership suggestions for the first 8 items (you can find the updated doc in the drive link Chloe shared).

For week 1 infra tests (min viable):
- Rate limit smoke: 1 minute burst to match expected peak traffic (we'll include a script and expected thresholds)
- 95th pct latency: synthetic run using a 10k token workload sample for your baseline prompt types
- Data retention smoke: confirm logs and KV cache expiry are visible in the console and sample audit event flows to your SIEM (we'll provide event key names)

I'll prep the test scripts and drop them as Gists + a runbook entry in the checklist. Jordan — can you prep a 5‑slide PDF version of the deck for execs? If you want, I can add a one‑liner on cost/latency tradeoffs for each slide.

—
Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>, Aaliyah Thompson <aaliyah@stardata.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 24 Jun 2024 15:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mutual Plan Starter — one‑page template + slide pack for 45d evaluation

Thanks — PDF slide pack uploaded to the drive (file: MAP_slide_pack_v1_exec.pdf). I condensed to 5 slides: value hypothesis, 45d milestones, tech checklist, risk/mitigation, next steps + stakeholder RACI.

Chloe / Ben: I've added short notes under each tech checklist item calling out the expected data we need from Stardata to run the tests (sample prompts, expected QPS, retention window). Aaliyah — if you can drop a sample prompt set and an expected QPS figure, we'll lock week 1 validations and publish a short test schedule.

Proposed next steps (short):
- Wed 26 Jun, 09:30am PT — 30min walkthrough (Chloe to send invite)
- Stardata provides sample prompts + QPS estimate by EOD Tue 25 Jun
- Ben to drop test scripts and runbook by EOD Tue 25 Jun

If procurement wants to run a questionnaire, recommend they do it after our initial validations (fewer surprises).

—
Jordan Blake
Customer Success | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com
